def blockLinear (A : ∀ i, E i →L[ℂ] F i) (C : ℝ) (_hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hA : ∀ i, ‖A i‖ ≤ C) : lp E 2 →ₗ[ℂ] lp F 2 where
  toFun x := ⟨fun i => A i (x i), by
    apply ((lp.memℓp x).norm.const_smul C).mono
    intro i
    exact (A i).le_opNorm (x i) |>.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hA i) (norm_nonneg _))⟩
  map_add' x y := by ext i; exact map_add (A i) _ _
  map_smul' c x := by ext i; exact map_smul (A i) _ _

def blockOperator (A : ∀ i, E i →L[ℂ] F i) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hA : ∀ i, ‖A i‖ ≤ C) : lp E 2 →L[ℂ] lp F 2 := by
  classical

  exact (OAI.CoarseAssembly.blockLinear A C hC hA).mkContinuous C ((
    let local_proof {ι : Type _} {E : ι → Type _} {F : ι → Type _} [inst_local_3 : (i : ι) → NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [inst_local_4 : (i : ι) → NormedSpace ℂ (E i)] [inst_local_5 : (i : ι) → NormedAddCommGroup (F i)] [inst_local_6 : (i : ι) → NormedSpace ℂ (F i)] (A : ∀ i, E i →L[ℂ] F i) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
        (hA : ∀ i, ‖A i‖ ≤ C) (x : lp E 2) :
        ‖OAI.CoarseAssembly.blockLinear A C hC hA x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ :=
      open OAI OAI.CoarseAssembly in
        open Filter in
        open scoped Topology in
        by
          calc
            _ ≤ ‖C • lp.toNorm x‖ := by
              apply lp.norm_mono (by norm_num : (2 : ENNReal) ≠ 0)
              intro i
              change ‖A i (x i)‖ ≤ ‖C * ‖x i‖‖
              rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC (norm_nonneg _))]
              exact (A i).le_opNorm (x i) |>.trans
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hA i) (norm_nonneg _))
            _ = C * ‖x‖ := by rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hC, lp.norm_toNorm]
    local_proof) A C hC hA)

def blockIsometry (V : ∀ i, E i →ₗᵢ[ℂ] F i) : lp E 2 →ₗᵢ[ℂ] lp F 2 where
  toLinearMap := (blockOperator (fun i => (V i).toContinuousLinearMap) 1 zero_le_one
    (fun i => (V i).norm_toContinuousLinearMap_le)).toLinearMap
  norm_map' x := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply lp.norm_mono (by norm_num : (2 : ENNReal) ≠ 0)
      intro i
      exact le_of_eq ((V i).norm_map (x i))
    · apply lp.norm_mono (by norm_num : (2 : ENNReal) ≠ 0)
      intro i
      exact le_of_eq ((V i).norm_map (x i)).symm

noncomputable def operatorConjugation (V : E →ₗᵢ[ℂ] F) (T : E →L[ℂ] E) : F →L[ℂ] F :=
  V.toContinuousLinearMap ∘L T ∘L V.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint

  have OAI.CoarseAssembly.operatorConjugation_mul {E : Type _} {F : Type _} [inst_local_2 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_local_3 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_local_4 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_local_5 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_local_6 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_local_7 : CompleteSpace F] (V : E →ₗᵢ[ℂ] F) (T S : E →L[ℂ] E) :

    open OAI OAI.CoarseAssembly in
    by
      have hV (z : E) : V.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (V z) = z := by
        simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, one_apply_eq_self,
          LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap] using DFunLike.congr_fun V.adjoint_comp_self z
      ext x
      simp [OAI.CoarseAssembly.operatorConjugation, hV]
  exact {
    toFun := OAI.CoarseAssembly.operatorConjugation V
    map_zero' := by simp [OAI.CoarseAssembly.operatorConjugation]
    map_add' T S := by simp [OAI.CoarseAssembly.operatorConjugation, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_add,
      ContinuousLinearMap.add_comp]
    map_mul' := OAI.CoarseAssembly.operatorConjugation_mul V
    map_smul' c T := by simp [OAI.CoarseAssembly.operatorConjugation]
    map_star' := (
    let local_proof {E : Type _} {F : Type _} [inst_local_2 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_local_3 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_local_4 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_local_5 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_local_6 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_local_7 : CompleteSpace F] (V : E →ₗᵢ[ℂ] F) (T : E →L[ℂ] E) :

namespace CoarseAssembly.Congruence

abbrev ArithmeticGroup := Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 3) ℤ

abbrev Quotient (k : ℕ) := Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 3) (ZMod (2 ^ k))

def reduce (k : ℕ) : ArithmeticGroup →* Quotient k :=
  Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod (2 ^ k)))

def diagonal {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (t : Rˣ) : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 3) R :=
  ⟨Matrix.diagonal ![(t : R), ((t⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R), 1], by
    simp [Matrix.det_diagonal, Fin.prod_univ_succ]⟩

noncomputable def holonomy (t : ℤ_[2]ˣ) (k : ℕ) : Quotient k :=
  diagonal (Units.map (PadicInt.toZModPow k).toMonoidHom t)

end CoarseAssembly.Congruence

namespace CoarseAssembly.Congruence

def residueMap {l k : ℕ} (h : l ≤ k) : ZMod (2 ^ k) →+* ZMod (2 ^ l) :=
  ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow 2 h) _

def quotientMap {l k : ℕ} (h : l ≤ k) : Quotient k →* Quotient l :=
  Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map (residueMap h)

end CoarseAssembly.Congruence

namespace CoarseAssembly

@[instance_reducible] def discreteGraphMetric (V : Type*) : MetricSpace V := by
  classical
  exact {
    dist := fun x y => if x = y then 0 else 1
    dist_self := by intro x; simp
    dist_comm := by intro x y; by_cases hxy : x = y <;> simp_all [eq_comm]
    dist_triangle := by intro x y z; split_ifs <;> simp_all
    eq_of_dist_eq_zero := by
      intro x y hdist
      by_contra hxy
      simp [hxy] at hdist
  }

variable {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V)

@[instance_reducible] def connectedGraphMetric (hG : G.Connected) : MetricSpace V where
  dist x y := (G.dist x y : ℝ)
  dist_self x := (congrArg (fun distance : ℕ => (distance : ℝ)) (G.dist_self (v := x))).trans
    Nat.cast_zero
  dist_comm x y := congrArg (fun distance : ℕ => (distance : ℝ)) (G.dist_comm (u := x) (v := y))
  dist_triangle x y z :=
    (show (G.dist x z : ℝ) ≤ ((G.dist x y + G.dist y z : ℕ) : ℝ) from
      Nat.cast_le.mpr (hG.dist_triangle (u := x) (v := y) (w := z))).trans_eq (Nat.cast_add _ _)
  eq_of_dist_eq_zero := by
    intro x y h
    exact hG.dist_eq_zero_iff.mp (Nat.cast_eq_zero.mp h)

@[instance_reducible] def graphMetricOrDiscrete : MetricSpace V := by
  classical
  exact if hG : G.Connected then connectedGraphMetric G hG else discreteGraphMetric V

end CoarseAssembly

  max (max |u.1| |u.2|) |u.1 + u.2|

  Adj u v := |u.1 - v.1| ≤ 1 ∧ |u.2 - v.2| ≤ 1 ∧

  loopless := ⟨fun _ h => h.2.2.2 rfl⟩

  operator : End space
  commutator_compact : ∀ a : A,
    IsCompactOperator (operator * representation a - representation a * operator : End space)
  square_compact : ∀ a : A,
    IsCompactOperator ((operator * operator - 1) * representation a : End space)
  adjoint_compact : ∀ a : A,
    IsCompactOperator ((star operator - operator) * representation a : End space)

variable {A} {B : Type u} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

namespace OddCycle

def Degenerate (c : OddCycle A) : Prop :=
  (∀ a, c.operator * c.representation a - c.representation a * c.operator = 0) ∧
  (∀ a, (c.operator * c.operator - 1) * c.representation a = 0) ∧
  (∀ a, (star c.operator - c.operator) * c.representation a = 0)

def precomp (c : OddCycle A) (φ : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) : OddCycle B where
  space := c.space
  representation := c.representation.comp φ
  operator := c.operator
  commutator_compact b := c.commutator_compact (φ b)
  square_compact b := c.square_compact (φ b)
  adjoint_compact b := c.adjoint_compact (φ b)

structure UnitaryEquivalent (c d : OddCycle A) where
  unitary : c.space ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] d.space
  representation_eq : ∀ a,
    d.representation a = operatorConjugation unitary.toLinearIsometry (c.representation a)
  operator_eq : d.operator = operatorConjugation unitary.toLinearIsometry c.operator

def UnitaryEquivalent.precomp {c d : OddCycle A} (e : UnitaryEquivalent c d)
    (φ : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) : UnitaryEquivalent (c.precomp φ) (d.precomp φ) where
  unitary := e.unitary
  representation_eq b := e.representation_eq (φ b)
  operator_eq := e.operator_eq

structure IsDirectSum (c d e : OddCycle A) where
  left : c.space →ₗᵢ[ℂ] e.space
  right : d.space →ₗᵢ[ℂ] e.space
  orthogonal : left.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint ∘L right.toContinuousLinearMap = 0
  exhaustive : left.toContinuousLinearMap.comp left.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint +
    right.toContinuousLinearMap.comp right.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint = 1
  representation_eq : ∀ a,
    e.representation a = operatorConjugation left (c.representation a) +
      operatorConjugation right (d.representation a)
  operator_eq : e.operator = operatorConjugation left c.operator +
    operatorConjugation right d.operator

    (φ : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) : IsDirectSum (c.precomp φ) (d.precomp φ) (e.precomp φ) where
  left := h.left
  right := h.right
  orthogonal := h.orthogonal
  exhaustive := h.exhaustive

abbrev Interval := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1

def start : Interval := ⟨0, by norm_num⟩

def finish : Interval := ⟨1, by norm_num⟩

structure OddHomotopy (A : Type u) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] where
  space : HilbertSpace.{u}
  representation : Interval → A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] End space
  operator : Interval → End space
  continuous_representation : ∀ a, Continuous (fun t => representation t a)
  continuous_operator : Continuous operator
  commutator_compact : ∀ t a,
    IsCompactOperator (operator t * representation t a - representation t a * operator t : End space)
  square_compact : ∀ t a,
    IsCompactOperator ((operator t * operator t - 1) * representation t a : End space)
  adjoint_compact : ∀ t a,
    IsCompactOperator ((star (operator t) - operator t) * representation t a : End space)

namespace OddHomotopy

def eval (h : OddHomotopy A) (t : Interval) : OddCycle A where
  space := h.space
  representation := h.representation t
  operator := h.operator t
  commutator_compact := h.commutator_compact t
  square_compact := h.square_compact t
  adjoint_compact := h.adjoint_compact t

def precomp (h : OddHomotopy A) (φ : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) : OddHomotopy B where
  space := h.space
  representation t := (h.representation t).comp φ
  operator := h.operator
  continuous_representation b := h.continuous_representation (φ b)
  continuous_operator := h.continuous_operator
  commutator_compact t b := h.commutator_compact t (φ b)
  square_compact t b := h.square_compact t (φ b)
  adjoint_compact t b := h.adjoint_compact t (φ b)

end OddHomotopy

  map_star' a := by ext x; rfl

  space : ℕ → Type u
  topology : ∀ n, TopologicalSpace (space n)

  pushforward (C.inclusion r s h)

def inclusionHom (e : X ↪ Y) (he : ∀ x y, dist (e x) (e y) ≤ dist x y) :

  let V : Module X H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Module Y H := inclusionIsometry e
  let φ : Operator X H →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] Operator Y H := operatorConjugationHom V
  have vector_apply (v : Module X H) (x : X) : V v (e x) = v x := by
    change extendedFunction e v (e x) = v x
    exact e.injective.extend_apply _ _ _
  have vector_zero (v : Module X H) (y : Y) (hy : y ∉ Set.range e) : V v y = 0 := by
    change extendedFunction e v y = 0
    exact Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ hy
  have isometry_single (x : X) (h : H) : V (lp.single 2 x h) = lp.single 2 (e x) h := by
    apply lp.ext
    funext y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.range e
    · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy
      rw [vector_apply]
      simp only [lp.single_apply, Pi.single_apply, e.injective.eq_iff]
    · rw [vector_zero _ y hy]
      exact (lp.single_apply_ne (E := fun _ : Y => H) 2 (e x) h
        (fun hxy => hy ⟨x, hxy.symm⟩)).symm

    apply ext_inner_left ℂ
    intro h
    calc
      inner ℂ h (V.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint v x) =
          inner ℂ (lp.single 2 x h) (V.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint v) :=
        (lp.inner_single_left (𝕜 := ℂ) (G := fun _ : X => H) x h
          (V.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint v)).symm

        ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right _ _ _
      _ = inner ℂ (lp.single 2 (e x) h) v :=
        congrArg (fun w => inner ℂ w v) (isometry_single x h)
      _ = inner ℂ h (v (e x)) := lp.inner_single_left (𝕜 := ℂ) (G := fun _ : Y => H) (e x) h v

    ext h

    ext h

    ext h

      apply lp.ext
      funext z
      rw [adjoint_apply]
      exact lp.single_apply_ne (E := fun _ : Y => H) 2 y h (fun hzy => hy ⟨z, hzy⟩)
    change V (T (V.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (lp.single 2 y h))) x = 0
    rw [hz, map_zero, map_zero]
    rfl
  have compact_congr {S T : H →L[ℂ] H} (h : S = T) (hT : IsCompactOperator T.toFun) :
      IsCompactOperator S.toFun := by
    cases h
    exact hT
  have compact {T : Operator X H} (hT : CompactEntries T) : CompactEntries (φ T) := by
    intro x y
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range e
    · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
      by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.range e
      · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hy
        exact compact_congr (entry_eq T a b) (hT a b)
      · exact compact_congr (entry_col_zero T _ _ hy)
          (show IsCompactOperator (0 : H →L[ℂ] H).toFun from isCompactOperator_zero)
    · exact compact_congr (entry_row_zero T _ _ hx)
        (show IsCompactOperator (0 : H →L[ℂ] H).toFun from isCompactOperator_zero)
  have propagation {T : Operator X H} {r : ℝ} (hT : PropagationLE r T) : PropagationLE r (φ T) := by
    intro x y hxy
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range e
    · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
      by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.range e
      · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hy
        exact (entry_eq T a b).trans (hT a b (hxy.trans_le (he a b)))
      · exact entry_col_zero T _ _ hy
    · exact entry_row_zero T _ _ hx

    obtain ⟨⟨r, hr, hprop⟩, hc, hcs⟩ := hT
    refine ⟨⟨r, hr, propagation hprop⟩, compact hc, ?_⟩
    simpa only [map_star] using compact hcs
  have hφ : Continuous φ := by
    change Continuous (fun T : Operator X H =>
      V.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (T.comp V.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint))
    exact continuous_const.clm_comp (continuous_id.clm_comp continuous_const)
  have hgen (T : Operator X H) (hT : Generator T) : φ T ∈ algebra (X := Y) (H := H) :=
    (NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.le_topologicalClosure _)
      (NonUnitalStarAlgebra.subset_adjoin ℂ _ (generator hT))
  refine conjugationHom V ?_
  intro T hT
  change φ T ∈ algebra (X := Y) (H := H)
  let SX : Set (Operator X H) :=
    (NonUnitalStarAlgebra.adjoin ℂ {T : Operator X H | Generator T} : Set (Operator X H))
  let SY : Set (Operator Y H) := (algebra (X := Y) (H := H) : Set (Operator Y H))
  have hclosed : IsClosed SY := by
    change IsClosed (closure ((NonUnitalStarAlgebra.adjoin ℂ
      {T : Operator Y H | Generator T}) : Set (Operator Y H)))
    exact isClosed_closure
  have hle : NonUnitalStarAlgebra.adjoin ℂ {T : Operator X H | Generator T} ≤
      (algebra (X := Y) (H := H)).comap φ := NonUnitalStarAlgebra.adjoin_le hgen
  have hmap : SX ⊆ φ ⁻¹' SY := hle
  have ht : T ∈ closure SX := hT
  exact (closure_minimal hmap (hclosed.preimage hφ)) ht

end CoarseAssembly.DiscreteRoe

        ¬ Function.Injective (constructedCoarseAssembly.toIntLinearMap.lTensor ℚ) := by
  sorry

end CoarseAssembly

end
end

end OAI
